generic-boilerplate-non-orienting.why: Cites generic section headings and generic field labels alike.

non-distinct-siblings-relational.why: Non-distinct sibling headings and repeated form-field labels both fail relationally.

icon-graphical-label-context.why: Graphical/icon labels on form controls and buttons; 5.B allows graphical labels.

label-omits-data-requirements.why: Form-field labels missing data-format/required cues; directly invokes TT 5.B/G131.

ambiguous-button-action-label.why: Button/control labels not conveying function; 5.B's explicit button-label prong.

descriptiveness-depends-on-layout-or-sta.why: Heading-to-content adequacy under visual reading order and collapsed disclosure state.

visible-vs-accessible-name-divergence.why: Divergence affects both visible form labels and visible headings.
